tools.name: list_levels
tools.description: The levels with a question bank (IYT courses, the Racing Rules of Sailing, the charter check-in): topics, number of questions, mock-exam settings and which topics have a theory article.

tools.name: get_questions
tools.description: Random practice questions of a level, of one topic or difficulty when given, without the answers.

tools.name: check_answer
tools.description: Whether an option of a question is right: the right option, the one-line note that names the rule, and the theory section that explains it.

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Questions whose text, options, rule reference or topic have the words (e.g. "cardinal mark", "MAYDAY"), without the answers.

tools.name: start_mock_exam
tools.description: A mock exam of a level: the exam's number of questions spread evenly over all topics, with the time allowed and the pass mark, without the answers.

tools.name: grade_exam
tools.description: The marks of a finished mock exam: the score, pass or fail, the result per topic, every mistake with the right answer and its note, and the theory sections to read. A question with option null was not answered and counts as wrong.

tools.name: question_of_the_day
tools.description: Today's question, the same one the Telegram bot @iyt_test_bot sends: one text question per day (UTC), for one level when a level is given, without the answer.

tools.name: list_theory
tools.description: The theory articles: one per topic, each in sections. With a level, the sections of its articles; without, which topics of every level have an article. Some topics have no article yet.

tools.name: get_theory
tools.description: A theory article, or one section of it, as text: the rule, the reason, tables and links to the drawings. Study notes close to the syllabus, not official IYT text.

tools.name: search_theory
tools.description: The sections of the theory articles that have the words (e.g. "scope", "cardinal marks"), with an excerpt of each.

tools.name: explain_question
tools.description: A question with its answer, the note that names the rule and the full text of the theory section that explains it.

tools.name: practice_section
tools.description: The questions on what a theory section explains, at random, without the answers.

tools.name: get_figure
tools.description: The drawing of a question or of a theory section as SVG markup.
